summary: @nebula.js/sn-map preinstall drops Bun runtime to execute obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package declares a `preinstall` script that runs `node setup.mjs`. `setup.mjs` is obfuscated with `_0x`-style identifier mangling and string-array lookup indirection, and downloads the Bun runtime archive from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/<archive>.zip`, extracts and chmods it, and invokes it via `execFileSync` on a sibling file `math_init.js` in the package directory. `math_init.js` is a 727 KB `// @bun @bun-cjs`-headed bundle wrapped in string-array-rotation obfuscation (`function WV8StW(...){...MmgoCP.push(MmgoCP.shift())...}`) with a large mixed-literal opcode array. The bundle's name and format are unrelated to the package's advertised Qlik nebula.js map/geospatial visualization purpose. The pattern hands install-time execution to a freshly-downloaded second-language runtime to run an intentionally opaque payload, evading Node-based inspection.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
